verdict.rationale: Jan is an AI chat assistant that runs local or cloud LLMs. Its docs say it can work autonomously on your files, run commands and do web research (jan-docs-13, jan-docs-14), and connect to data sources through MCP (jan-gh-5, jan-docs-8), so the AI can reason over user data inside the app. However, nothing shows a dedicated insights or suggestions feature that proactively analyzes your data; insights come only from prompting the assistant. Missing for 10: an explicit data-analysis, insights or proactive-suggestions feature, document/RAG chat over user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
